body.instructions: CONTEXT: This is a speaker-turn timeline of one outpatient room around the moment a doctor opened a patient's record (t+00:00). Each row is 30 seconds. DOC is the room's doctor; the other letters are other voices. A null value means no evidence, not silence. Examination silences of 1 to 4 minutes with the same voices afterwards are part of the consult. The next patient's record opening (next_start) usually comes after this consult has ended. QUESTION: What kind of activity is this segment? RULES: A consult ends when the patient leaves the room (V, 10 Oct 2026). The end row is the last row in which the patient is still in the room. The doctor talking alone afterwards (typing, dictating, calling the next patient) is after the consult end. Note submission is the encounter end; it is not this question and not a choice here. A brief staff voice is not a new patient. Answer only from the timeline.

criteria.consultation: One doctor and a patient (with or without companions) have a consultation.
criteria.multiple_consultations: The segment holds more than one consultation, one after another.
criteria.staff_or_admin: Staff or administrative talk, not a consultation.
criteria.doctor_alone_talk: Only the doctor speaks (calls, dictation, notes aloud).
criteria.empty_room: Nobody speaks; the room is empty or silent.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The timeline does not let you tell.
